**2. The journal spine is still unbuilt — and #2869 hasn't landed.** #2871's journal is pre-#2869. And my design note **PR #2869 is still OPEN with failing CI** (`UNSTABLE`), so the design of record isn't merged yet. That has to land (and its CI fixed) before the journal work, or the implementer builds against an unmerged spec. [...] **Coordination caveat:** #2871 is a live WIP under the owner account and `@codex1`/`@codex5` are shown "working" right now — dispatching a fresh agent at the same branch risks a collision. Safest sequencing: land #2869 first, then have **one** agent continue #2871. [...] > **Do not scaffold `nmp-wallet` — it already exists on branch `codex/2864-wallet-phase1-slice` (PR #2871, WIP draft).** Check out and build on that branch. First confirm no other agent is actively pushing it (it's a live WIP); if it is, coordinate/hand off rather than double-committing.
>
> **Prerequisite:** the design of record is **PR #2869** (three-concern split + event-sourced `WalletFact` reducer + causal trail, appended to `docs/architecture/nip60-nip61-wallet-design.md`). It must be merged first (its CI is currently red — check and fix before relying on it). Read that section, plus epic #2864 Phase 1, ADR-0075, and `crate-boundaries.md` §8.
